title: Task result response
description: 200 response to POST /api/v1/tasks/<id>/result. The agent marks the result reported in its ledger and stops retrying.

duplicate.description: True when the server already had this same result, so nothing changed.

applied.description: True when the result decided the task's state. False when the server had already ended the task itself (for example timed_out, expired, failed with lease_expired, or cancelled): the result is kept as an annotation beside the task and the state does not change.

state.description: The task's state on the server after this request.
